title: ARCHON Session Plan
description: Output of src/runtime/session-planner.js — how many controlled project sessions a mission needs and how many run concurrently now. Persisted at var/intel/session-plan-<taskId>.json. session_count is PLANNED capacity; active_concurrency is how many run now (quota-adjusted). Never spawn more sessions to solve rate limits.

session_count.description: planned capacity (ladder by feature count, capped at 5)

active_concurrency.description: how many sessions run concurrently now (quota-adjusted, <= session_count)

reason.description: human-readable explanation of the chosen counts (required — the planner must explain itself)
